🧠 Short Description

This project implements an advanced predictive maintenance pipeline using real industrial sensor time-series data. It combines deep learning via LSTM networks with statistical models and anomaly detection using Pandas and Statsmodels. The system forecasts future sensor values and predicts equipment degradation, enabling preventive action before failures occur.

📊 Example Input & Expected Output

Example Input:

  • A CSV file named real_sensor_data.csv with columns like timestamp, sensor_1, sensor_2, …

Expected Output:

  • A time-series visualization of sensor readings.
  • Stationarity test results (ADF statistics).
  • LSTM model predictions overlayed on real data.

🔑 Key Learnings & Concepts

  • Time-Series Forecasting
  • Predictive Maintenance Modeling
  • LSTM Architectures
  • Augmented Time-Series Preprocessing
  • Stationarity Testing with ADF (Augmented Dickey-Fuller)
  • Keras Sequential API + Dropout regularization
  • Data normalization & scaling
  • Deep Learning interpretability
  • Model evaluation via visualization

Keywords: #LSTM #PredictiveMaintenance #SensorData #DeepLearning #TimeSeries #DataScience #MachineLearning #Statsmodels #Keras #AnomalyDetection

🌐 Dataset Source

For this project, real-world datasets can be pulled from:

  • UCI Machine Learning Repository
  • Or you may use Kaggle’s predictive maintenance datasets

🧭 Problem Domain

Industrial IoT / Manufacturing Optimization / Smart Factories — forecasting component failure and managing sensor health in real-time.

🧰 Frameworks Used

  • Pandas
  • Statsmodels
  • Keras (TensorFlow backend)
  • Scikit-learn
  • Matplotlib & Seaborn

🔄 Development Lifecycle

  1. Business Problem Framing
  2. Data Collection & Acquisition
  3. Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
  4. Stationarity Testing (ADF)
  5. Preprocessing & Sequence Engineering
  6. Model Design (LSTM Architecture)
  7. Training & Validation
  8. Testing & Error Analysis
  9. Visualization & Interpretation
  10. Deployment (can be converted to REST API via FastAPI)
  11. Monitoring & Retraining

🔗 Sister Projects

  • Smart Grid Load Forecasting
  • Wind Turbine Anomaly Detection
  • Predictive Vehicle Maintenance
  • Power Plant Efficiency Analysis

🤝 Integration Targets

  • SCADA Systems
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS IoT, Azure Digital Twins)
  • Enterprise ERP systems
  • Maintenance Ticketing Software (CMMS)

🗓️ Timestamp

Date: 2025-05-23
Estimated Time to Completion: 8–12 days (including model optimization & documentation)

🧪 Final Product

  • A fully operational ML pipeline that can ingest sensor data, run stationarity tests, forecast failure, and generate plots for engineers.
  • Plug-and-play LSTM model for predictive maintenance use-cases.
  • Extensible architecture for multi-sensor forecasting.

💎 Pro-Level Challenges Implemented

  • Advanced ADF statistical validation
  • LSTM multivariate time-series modeling with 3D data reshaping
  • Visual diagnostic overlays on model predictions
  • SOLID, modular, and decoupled pipeline components
  • EarlyStopping to prevent overfitting
  • Framework extensibility hooks

🚀 Where To Go From Here

  • Integrate Bayesian techniques or Kalman filters for uncertainty estimation.
  • Add REST API endpoints for real-time inference.
  • Train on Edge using TensorFlow Lite.
  • Connect with dashboards like Grafana for live visualization.
  • Implement Self-Healing triggers based on prediction confidence.
